subject: Next steps: rotating demo slots for cross-region stakeholders
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Patrick O'Neill <patrick.oneill@acmeanalytics.com>, Sara Liang <sara.liang@fintechsolutions.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: rotating demo slots for cross-region stakeholders

Hi Patrick & Sara —

Great to meet you both on today's discovery. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary use case: low-latency recommendation API for personalized dashboards (batch + near-real-time inference).
- Key constraints: 99th pct latency goal of <120ms for API responses, strict audit logs for PCI-adjacent data, and preference for private deployment options.
- Stakeholders: Patrick (Product), Sara (Security), plus an engineering lead for the deep technical dive.

Next step proposal: schedule a 60-min technical deep dive with our inference engineers and your eng lead. Because the team spans US/EU/APAC, I propose a recurring rotating time-slot model so each region has at least one favorable meeting time per quarter. Suggested rotation (attached as a CSV + .ics):

1) Week A: US-friendly window (09:00–11:00 PDT) — engineers: Marcus / Ben
2) Week B: EU-friendly window (14:00–16:00 CEST) — engineers: Marcus / Soojin
3) Week C: APAC-friendly window (08:00–10:00 AEST) — engineers: Ben / Marcus

Pls see attached "proposed-time-slot-grid.ics" for a sample 4-week rotation and "acme-discovery-notes.pdf" for the call notes.

Can you confirm: (a) who from your engineering team should join the deep dive, and (b) which of these rotation weeks looks best to kick off (we can be flexible next two weeks)?

If it's helpful I can send a Doodle or propose 3 candidate slots and lock one in.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Attachment: acme-discovery-notes.pdf (summary of discovery call)
Attachment: proposed-time-slot-grid.ics (sample rotating calendar)

From: Patrick O'Neill <patrick.oneill@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Liang <sara.liang@fintechsolutions.io>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 11:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Next steps: rotating demo slots for cross-region stakeholders

Thanks Soojin — super helpful summary.

We're keen to move forward. Quick answers:
- I'll loop in our engineering lead, Javier Cruz (javier.cruz@acmeanalytics.com), for the technical deep dive. Please include him on the invite.
- The rotation idea makes sense. For the first session we'd prefer an EU-friendly window if possible (we have a couple of offshore teams who can join late evening APAC, but EU is easiest).

Availability next week for a 60-min slot (CEST):
- Wed 11 Aug: 15:00–16:00 CEST
- Thu 12 Aug: 10:00–11:00 CEST (tight for Product but possible)

If you can send a firm invite for Wed 11 Aug 15:00–16:00 CEST that works for Product/Security (Sara) and I'll confirm with Eng. Also please include a brief agenda: topology review, latency targets and test harness, data retention & audit logging.

On the audit logging side Sara may have a short questionnaire; she'll send that separately.

—Patrick
Product Lead | Acme Analytics
patrick.oneill@acmeanalytics.com

Soojin —

Thanks for the heads-up. I can cover the model serving topology, KV cache behavior, and latency profiling during the deep dive. Ben and I can rotate as proposed; Ben will lead the APAC-friendly sessions.

Two quick asks from engineering before we finalize the invite:
1) Do we have a sample payload size and 95/99 latency SLAs (Patrick mentioned 99th <120ms; is 95th target tighter?)
2) Will there be a test account or sandbox dataset to run against, or will we demo on synthetic data? If Acme wants a live run, we'll need a short NDA and details on data sensitivity.

If Wed 11 Aug 15:00–16:00 CEST is the kickoff, I can block that time and prepare a short slide deck + sample probe script.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Patrick / Javier / Sara —

Thanks for the quick replies. Confirmed: Wed, 11 Aug 2026, 15:00–16:00 CEST will be our kickoff deep dive and the first entry in a recurring rotating cadence.

Agenda (60m):
- 5m: Introductions & goals
- 20m: Serving topology & latency profiling (Marcus)
- 15m: Integration & auth (Ben)
- 15m: Audit logs / security Q&A (Soojin + Sara)
- 5m: Next steps / action items

Practicals: I've created a calendar invite and attached the .ics (proposed-time-slot-grid.ics). Please accept the invite and add Javier to the event if he doesn't auto-appear. HubSpot record: HS-Contact-5921, Deal RD-4932.

Marcus — for the sample payloads: Patrick confirmed 99th <120ms. Patrick / Javier — if you can share a 90–95th percentile size (approx. token counts or JSON payload size) before Tue 10 Aug EOD that helps us prepare an accurate probe.

If anyone prefers a different kickoff week we'll re-rotate, but this aligns with the team's availability today.

Cheers,
Soojin
